description: Bitcraze's pocket quadcopter: a single circuit board that is frame, flight controller and power system in one, with four 7 mm coreless motors and a 250 mAh LiPo. Every value is from the official Crazyflie 2.1 datasheet (Rev 3).
name: crazyflie-2-1

connections.label: direct drive from the board (voltage not specified)

nodes.label: Crazyflie 2.1 flight board
nodes.req_label: single-board design: frame, power and flight control on one PCB

wiring.note: The Crazyflie is a single-board design: the battery plugs straight into the flight board and the board drives the four coreless motors directly — there is no separate power distribution to document. Motor drive voltage is not specified in the datasheet, so that connection carries no voltage and is never voltage-checked.
